title: Parent path segments are deleted without resolving their directory
request: Fix normalizeRelative(path) in src/path.mjs. It accepts relative slash-separated paths, collapses repeated slashes and dot segments, and resolves each parent segment against the preceding directory. Refuse a parent traversal above the root, absolute paths, backslashes, colons and NUL. The normalized empty path is the empty string. Keep Unicode and names such as ..notes literal.
seededFailure: Filtering out parent segments turns a/b/../c into a/b/c instead of a/c, and accepts traversal above the root. A stack that silently pops an empty array repairs normal paths while still admitting escape attempts.
